answer: Require every claim to travel like a raven through strangers: each relayer adds one independent check before passing it on, and a public beacon randomly picks past chains for deep audit. Genuine chains branch like a willow, with wide, tangled ancestry. A sybil farm relaying among itself folds back on the same few ancestors, so its ancestry collapses — however many copies it spawns, the inbred chain earns no standing.
